hero.title: Data, guides and documents — published, not promised
hero.standfirst: Most LED suppliers describe their products. We publish the measurements: 22-point voltage grids, 90-minute thermal soaks, surge results and the full lab reports. Use them to compare us against whatever else you are evaluating.

faq.q: How often do you publish new resources?
faq.a: Test data, technical guides and downloadable documents are added as our engineering team completes new measurements. Check back periodically, or contact us for a document that is not listed yet.

faq.q: Do I need to register to download your documents?
faq.a: No. Every published document is free to download with no email gate. Certification files, IES/LDT photometric data, installation drawings and BOMs are available on request.

cta.title: Looking for a document that is not here?
cta.text: Certification files, IES/LDT photometric data, installation drawings and BOMs are available on request. Tell us the project and we will send the right pack.
